quests.question: Convert to reported speech: She said, 'I have been feeling unwell since Monday.'
options: She said she had been feeling unwell since Monday.
She said she has been feeling unwell since Monday.
She said she had felt unwell since Monday.
quests.correctAnswer: She said she had been feeling unwell since Monday.
quests.sentence: She said, 'I have been feeling unwell since Monday.'
quests.hint: Present perfect continuous → past perfect continuous. The time reference 'since Monday' stays.
quests.explanation: 'Have been feeling' shifts to 'had been feeling'. The continuous aspect must be preserved. 'Since Monday' is unchanged.

quests.question: Convert to reported speech: He asked, 'Would you prefer tea or coffee?'
options: He asked whether I would prefer tea or coffee.
He asked whether would I prefer tea or coffee.
He asked if I prefer tea or coffee.
quests.correctAnswer: He asked whether I would prefer tea or coffee.
quests.sentence: He asked, 'Would you prefer tea or coffee?'
quests.hint: 'Would' stays. 'You' → 'I'. Use 'whether' for alternative-choice questions.
quests.explanation: 'Would' does not shift further. 'You' becomes 'I'. 'Whether' is preferred when there are two alternatives.

quests.question: Convert to reported speech: She said, 'Please don't make changes without consulting me first.'
options: She asked them not to make any changes without consulting her first.
She asked them to not make changes without consulting me first.
She told them don't make any changes without consulting her first.
quests.correctAnswer: She asked them not to make any changes without consulting her first.
quests.sentence: She said, 'Please don't make changes without consulting me first.'
quests.hint: Polite negative command: 'asked + them + not to'. 'Me' → 'her'.
quests.explanation: 'Please don't make' → 'asked them not to make'. 'Consulting me' → 'consulting her'.

quests.question: Convert to reported speech: They said, 'We won't be able to meet the deadline unless we get more resources.'
options: They said they wouldn't be able to meet the deadline unless they got more resources.
They said they won't be able to meet the deadline unless they get more resources.
They said they wouldn't be able to meet the deadline unless they had got more resources.
quests.correctAnswer: They said they wouldn't be able to meet the deadline unless they got more resources.
quests.sentence: They said, 'We won't be able to meet the deadline unless we get more resources.'
quests.hint: 'Won't' → 'wouldn't'. 'We' → 'they'. In the conditional clause, 'get' → 'got'.
quests.explanation: 'Won't' → 'wouldn't'. In the conditional clause, 'get' shifts to 'got'. Both clauses must be updated.

quests.question: Convert to reported speech: The account manager asked, 'Did the client receive the proposal we sent yesterday?'
options: The account manager asked if the client had received the proposal they had sent the day before.
The account manager asked if the client received the proposal they sent yesterday.
The account manager asked did the client receive the proposal they sent the day before.
quests.correctAnswer: The account manager asked if the client had received the proposal they had sent the day before.
quests.sentence: The account manager asked, 'Did the client receive the proposal we sent yesterday?'
quests.hint: Multiple shifts: 'did receive' → 'had received', 'sent' → 'had sent', 'yesterday' → 'the day before'.
quests.explanation: Both verbs shift back: 'receive' → 'had received', 'sent' → 'had sent'. 'Yesterday' → 'the day before'. Use 'if' and statement order.

quests.question: Convert to reported speech: The security officer said, 'Contact us immediately if you notice anything suspicious.'

quests.sentence: The security officer said, 'Contact us immediately if you notice anything suspicious.'

quests.question: Convert to reported speech: They said, 'We were planning a surprise party when she walked in.'

quests.question: Convert to reported speech: The IT manager asked, 'Has anyone reported problems with the new system?'

quests.question: Convert to reported speech: The travel guide said, 'Charge your device fully before you travel.'
